multi-action button

Motion·by @nickpylll·2026-09-03·inspora page·original post

What it is

Mobile fintech FAB that expands into a vertical action menu (Receive/Send/Swap) with staggered spring entrances over a blurred backdrop, then collapses back.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-12%
Resting: home screen with balance card; black circular FAB with white plus bottom-right; background sharp.
12-25%
Tap FAB: backdrop blurs and dims; first item 'Receive' (orange download icon) pops in above FAB with overshoot.
25-45%
'Send' (purple paper-plane) and 'Swap' (blue arrows) cascade in, staggered ~75ms, each scaling 0.5->1 with spring; labels slide in from the right.
45-60%
Menu fully open and settled; backdrop stays blurred.
60-80%
Collapse: items fade/shrink in reverse stagger, labels exit first, icons scale to ~0.3 drifting toward the FAB origin.
80-100%
Backdrop un-blurs; plus icon returns (rotated back). Loop.

Build prompt

Build a mobile multi-action FAB. Resting: 56px circular black FAB with white plus icon fixed bottom-right above a tab bar. On tap: (1) animate a full-screen backdrop from blur(0) to blur(12px) with a 10% black dim over 300ms; (2) rotate the plus 45deg into a close icon over 200ms; (3) reveal a vertical stack of 3 action rows anchored above the FAB (Receive/orange download arrow, Send/purple paper plane, Swap/blue swap arrows), each row = filled circle icon + label to its left. Rows enter bottom-to-top with a 75ms stagger: scale 0.4->1 with spring overshoot (cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), 350ms), opacity 0->1 in the first 120ms, translateY +16px->0. On close: reverse stagger top-first, rows scale to 0.3 and fade over 200ms ease-in while drifting toward the FAB center, backdrop un-blurs over 250ms, icon rotates back. Hit targets >=44px; prefers-reduced-motion = cross-fade instead of springs.

Mechanics

trigger
tap on FAB
elements
FAB, backdrop blur layer, 3 action rows (icon+label)
properties
scale, opacity, translateY, backdrop-filter blur, plus->close rotation
timing
open ~450ms with 60-90ms stagger; close ~300ms reverse stagger
easing

loop
open-hold-close cycle
